name: Group Flights, Visas & Hotels
title: Group Flights, Bulk Visas & Hotel Blocks | ETHPL
meta: Group air fares, bulk visa processing and hotel room blocks for organisations — available on their own, without a full event booking.
tagline: The pieces, when you only need the pieces.
intro: Not every requirement is an event. Sometimes you have the agenda and the venue sorted and simply need sixty people moved, or forty visas processed, or a block of rooms held. These are available on their own.
included: Group air fares, including phased batches and charter assessment for large movements
Bulk visa processing with document checklists and status tracking
Hotel room blocks with a rooming list you control
One consolidated GST invoice instead of several vendor bills
questions: Can we use this without booking an event?
Yes. These are standalone services. Plenty of our work is a single workstream for a team that is otherwise self-sufficient.
When is a charter worth considering over block booking?
It depends on group size, route and how fixed your dates are. It is a real calculation rather than a rule of thumb, and we will show you the comparison for your specific movement.
How long does bulk visa processing take?
It varies by destination and by season, and consular timelines change. We will give you the current expected window for your destination at the time you ask, not a number from a brochure.
